caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) of two models, Transformer and MoHD, across varying numbers of sub-dimensions. The x-axis represents the numbers of sub-dims, with a linear scale, ranging from 16 to 256, and tick labels at 16, 32, 64, 128, and 256. The y-axis represents Eval PPL, with a linear scale, ranging from 9.5 to 12.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The Transformer model is represented by a red dashed line, which remains constant at approximately 11.7 across the x-axis. The MoHD model is represented by a blue solid line with square markers, starting at around 10.5 at 16 sub-dims, increasing to 10.7 at 128 sub-dims, and then slightly decreasing to 10.6 at 256 sub-dims.
